subject: general
question: Which among the following civic suggestions did Karnataka’s Deputy Chief Minister give in September 2025 to improve governance quality in Bengaluru?

options.text: Pay taxes, declare assets, hide nothing

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pay taxes, declare assets, hide nothing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Karnataka's Deputy Chief Minister (DCM)**, in September 2025, introduced a civic suggestion to improve governance in Bengaluru by encouraging citizens to **pay taxes, declare assets, and maintain transparency**.
 
• This recommendation emphasizes the importance of **financial accountability** among citizens to strengthen Bengaluru's governance system.
 
• It aims to create a transparent system where individuals and businesses declare their **assets and liabilities**, reducing corruption and increasing public trust in governance.
 
• Complying with tax payments and declaring assets ensures a steady flow of funds for the government to improve **infrastructure and civic services** in Bengaluru.
